brief: The 6 anti-aging habits actually backed by science.

slots.author: Clara Bennett
slots.subtitle: SIX DAILY RITUALS FOR RADIANT SKIN

slots.author: Clara Bennett
slots.title: DAILY DEFENSE
slots.body: Ultraviolet radiation accelerates collagen breakdown and pigmentation. Applying broad-spectrum SPF every morning is the single most proven way to prevent premature aging. Make it your non-negotiable final step.

slots.author: Clara Bennett
slots.title: VITAMIN C
slots.body: A potent antioxidant that neutralizes free radicals and brightens uneven tone. Used each morning beneath sunscreen, it visibly improves radiance and supports firmer skin over time.

slots.author: Clara Bennett
slots.title: RETINOL RENEW
slots.body: Retinoids increase cell turnover and stimulate collagen production at the cellular level. Start with a low concentration at night to smooth fine lines and refine texture gently.

slots.author: Clara Bennett
slots.title: DEEP HYDRATION
slots.body: A compromised barrier loses moisture and accentuates wrinkles. Layering a ceramide-rich moisturizer maintains elasticity and keeps the complexion plump, calm, and resilient throughout the day.

slots.author: Clara Bennett
slots.title: RESTORATIVE SLEEP
slots.body: During deep sleep, skin enters repair mode and cortisol drops significantly. Prioritizing seven to nine hours allows your cells to regenerate, revealing a smoother, more lifted appearance by morning.

slots.author: Clara Bennett
slots.title: GENTLE MOVEMENT
slots.body: Regular exercise enhances circulation, delivering oxygen and nutrients that nourish the skin from within. Even daily walks help flush toxins and promote the healthy glow that topicals alone cannot achieve.
